spm 0.4.0+742a52dcd9a0eaa02d45505a7dac9341e79652f3
spm (Skill and Plugin Manager) — a CLI, interactive REPL, and MCP server that installs AI agent skills from Git catalogs into every coding agent on your machine, following the open agent-skills conventions: one shared .agents/skills copy plus a link per agent. Find a skill by intent with ranked search, deploy it across every detected agent at once, keep deployments healthy with doctor/cleanup, or run spm as an MCP server so an agent can search and install skills itself.
Commands
Command                Description                                           
agents                 List the agents spm deploys to — folders, detection,  
                       and which share .agents/skills                        
catalog ...            List configured skill catalogs and their sync status  
cleanup                Clean stale spm artifacts — broken links, staging     
                       leftovers, stale clones, lost records. Preview by     
                       default; --apply to perform, folders go to quarantine 
config prompts <state> Turn the interactive-launch catalog offers (import    
                       featured / sync stale) on or off                      
doctor                 Diagnose local skill deployments: lost, partial,      
                       broken links, 0.3 layouts, orphaned or stale folders  
                       (read-only)                                           
info <skillName>       Show details about a skill: catalog, description,     
                       install status, references                            
install <skillName>    Deploy a skill to every detected AI agent — from your 
                       catalogs or straight from a GitHub repo (org/repo)    
list                   List skills across synced catalogs (optionally filter 
                       by catalog, or --installed)                           
resurrect              Review skills whose deployed files went missing;      
                       restore 
[truncated]

Description:  Deploy a skill to every detected AI agent — from your catalogs or

Name        Description

            from: org/repo or org/repo/skill                                 

Options
Name               Description                                               
--skills <string>  Comma-separated skill names to install from a GitHub repo 
                   (skips the picker)                                        
--agents <string>  Comma-separated agent keys to deploy to, e.g.             
                   claude-code,windsurf (skips the agent picker; see `spm    
                   agents`)                                                  
--catalog <string> Resolve the skill only from this catalog by name (used by 
                   update to pin a skill's source)                           
--project          Deploy only into the current project, even if you'd       
                   normally be asked [default: False]                        
--global           Deploy only to global agent configs, even when run inside 
                   a project [default: False]                                
--all              Deploy to both scopes: this project and global agent
